The main nutrients conifers need are nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P) and potassium (K), plus some trace elements, which are supplied by the microorganisms in GREENODIN BROWN. Feeding conifers in spring is especially important, as this is a period of active growth for many species. A base dose of GREENODIN BROWN improves soil structure, breaks down organic matter and delivers nutrients to the plants. Spread the organic fertilizer around the root zone and work it gently into the soil. Along with feeding, make sure conifers are watered regularly, especially during active growth in spring.

The components of GREENODIN BROWN help conifers strengthen their root system, preserve energy reserves and cope better with winter. Water conifers well before the frosts so they can store enough moisture in their tissues before winter dormancy.

Поливайте хвойні рослини регулярно, особ: Water conifers regularly, especially in dry spells. Keep in mind that different species may have different watering needs. Keep the root zone sufficiently moist and avoid both drying out and waterlogging.
Хвойні рослини переважно вирощуються в д: Conifers grow best in well-drained soil rich in organic matter. Make sure the soil drains well and the roots have free access to air.
Накривання ґрунту під хвойними рослинами: Mulching under conifers in autumn helps retain moisture, keep the soil temperature stable and protect the roots from freezing. Use organic mulch such as dry leaves, straw or bark and spread it around the base of the plants, ideally with a base dose of GREENODIN BROWN so that it breaks down better.
Виконуйте обрізку хвойних рослин для під: Prune conifers to maintain their shape, size and health. Remove dead, diseased or damaged branches to improve air circulation and keep growth healthy. Small dry twigs, bark and needles are a useful addition to mulch. Fertilizers for thuja

Добриво під кукурудзу, з яким добривом с: Searches like “fertilizer for maize”, “what fertilizer to sow maize with” or “complex fertilizer for grain maize” cannot give a simple answer to the key question: how do you grow organic grain maize properly? The answer is as comprehensive as GREENODIN's solutions and covers several essential topics: soil requirements; soil preparation; fertilization; sowing; crop care; top-dressing; irrigation; pests and diseases; harvesting; post-harvest tillage; and storing the crop.
Посадка кукурудзи у відкритий ґрунт. Вим: Sowing maize in the open field. Soil requirements
Добрими ґрунтами для вирощування кукуруд: Good soils for maize are deep chernozems, dark grey loams and floodplain soils with a permeable subsoil, where maize easily develops a mass of fibrous roots. Loose soil with good air and water permeability works best. Maize grown after GREENODIN GRAY gives excellent results (photo from June 2023: Dekalb hybrid at the 5–6 leaf stage). Maize needs oxygen, carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, calcium, sulphur, iron and magnesium, plus small amounts of manganese, boron, chlorine, iodine, zinc, copper and other trace elements.
Найбільша кількість поживних речовин пот: Maize needs the most nutrients when cobs form and grain fills. Up to the dough stage it takes up macro- and micronutrients at different rates depending on the growth phase. In the first half of the season it needs more phosphorus, potassium and nitrogen, and after flowering more phosphorus and potassium. Correct soil fertilization and crop top-dressing are the most important conditions for high yields.
При цьому, на розвиток рослини дуже силь: Soil pH has a strong effect on plant development; the optimum is pH 5.5–7.0, as it directly determines how available these nutrients are to maize and how drought-tolerant the crop is. For example, below pH 5.5 the availability of magnesium, calcium, potassium and molybdenum drops.
Якщо ваш грунт лужний >7,5pH, рекомендує: If your soil is alkaline (pH above 7.5), use GREENODIN BROWN at 250 kg/ha, or 25 g/m². While soil pH can be corrected with GREENODIN organic fertilizers, think twice before sowing organic maize on soils infested with rhizomatous and creeping-root weeds such as sow thistle, Russian knapweed, couch grass and others. Основна обробка ґрунту. Коренева система: Primary tillage. The maize root system develops gradually in all directions, with 70% of it in the top 30 cm of soil, so the crop is very sensitive to ploughing depth.
Головним завданням основної обробки є ст: The main goal of primary tillage is to maximise the accumulation and conservation of soil moisture without weakening weed control. After solid-seeded crops, primary tillage for maize usually consists of two operations: stubble discing and autumn ploughing. In areas with a long frost-free period, two passes of discing give the best weed control, the second one 10–12 cm deep, 3–4 weeks after the first. This destroys over 70% of weeds and halves the weed seed bank in the soil.
На полях, засмічених кореневищними бур'я: On fields infested with rhizomatous weeds, including couch grass and horsetail, cross-discing is done to a depth of 10–14 cm. Where creeping perennial weeds such as sow thistle and field bindweed are present, discing is repeated after 2–3 weeks. In a soil-conserving non-inversion system, the soil is loosened with a harrow right after harvest, followed by two passes with a sweep cultivator: first to 8–10 cm, then to 12–14 cm.
Передпосівна обробка. Передпосівний обро: Pre-sowing tillage. Pre-sowing tillage for maize follows discing without delay so that soil moisture is not lost. Maize needs two cultivations at different depths with harrowing, plus rolling in dry, windy weather. The depth of cultivation, especially the first, depends on soil type and weather. In most areas with insufficient moisture, the first cultivation should be deeper and the second shallower, to seeding depth.
Споживання поживних речовин кукурудзою з: Maize takes up nutrients from the soil throughout the growing season. Nitrogen and potassium uptake ends earlier, while phosphorus keeps entering the plants almost until maturity.
Вносять добрива з осені чи навесні, під: Fertilizers are applied in autumn or spring before ploughing or cultivation (base fertilizer), at sowing, and as top-dressing during the growing season.

Maize covers 50–85% of its nitrogen needs by fixing it from the atmosphere, and the nitrogen-fixing bacteria in GREENODIN are enough for this. Phosphorus (P) stimulates the development of the root system and most of the reproductive organs that form the yield; the phosphate-solubilising bacteria in GREENODIN do this job very well. Together with silicon, potassium actively raises yield, increases protein content, supports nitrogen fixation and strengthens resistance to disease and stress, all boosted by the potassium-mobilising bacteria in GREENODIN. Calcium (Ca), which is part of GREENODIN, improves soil structure, the uptake of other elements and maize root development. необхідний протягом усього вегетаційного: It is needed throughout the growing season, especially during flowering, kernel set and grain formation. On the other hand, seeding too shallow is also a mistake, as the seeds end up in the dry topsoil and germinate poorly. In each case, seeding depth depends on the sowing date, soil moisture and texture, and spring weather, especially temperature.
Повноцінні, дружні сходи можна отримати: Strong, even emergence comes from placing seed at a depth where it has enough moisture, air and warmth. In the dry and semi-arid south on chernozems, the best conditions are usually at 8–10 cm, or 10–12 cm if the soil has dried out a lot by sowing time, depending on soil quality, moisture and sowing date. Перший раз боронують через 5-6 днів післ: The first harrowing is done 5–6 days after sowing, while weeds are still white thread-like sprouts that have not yet reached the surface. Do not be late, as the weeds will grow stronger and harrows will no longer kill them. If wet weather delays maize emergence and weeds start sprouting again, harrow once more.

The most dangerous include wireworms (click beetle larvae), darkling beetle and pollen beetle larvae, cutworm caterpillars, frit fly larvae, the southern grey weevil and European corn borer caterpillars. Among mammals, ground squirrels and mice cause serious damage.
Відчутну шкоду завдають також інші види: Other insects also cause noticeable damage: beet webworm, western corn rootworm, cotton bollworm and cabbage moth, cereal ground beetle, Lethrus beetle, mole cricket, aphids and flea beetles. Maize protection combines organisational, agronomic and biological methods. Used together, they reliably protect the crop from losses.
Для захисту кукурудзи від хвороб та шкід: Proper preparation for sowing is very important for protecting maize from diseases and pests. One of the key measures is treating the seed with Mikohelp and Fitohelp. The same products are used as foliar treatments during the season, together with the bio-insecticides Lepidocid, Bitoxibacillin and Actoverm Formula. The bio-adjuvants Enposam and Liposam are also effective. Correct placement of maize in the rotation is very important for preventing diseases and pests, as changing crops limits contact with pathogens and pests.

For example, to reduce the southern grey weevil, it is especially important to rotate maize and sunflower with small grains.
При сівбі в оптимальні терміни кукурудза: Maize sown at the optimal time suffers less from diseases and pests. Sowing too early leads to heavy seed mould and increases root and stalk rots, wireworm and mole cricket damage. Plants from very late sowings suffer more from common smut and head smut, frit fly and turnip moth, and immature cobs are more susceptible to Nigrospora ear rot, cotton bollworm and mould both in the field and in storage.
Закладення насіння на нормальну глибину: Seeding at the normal depth (8 cm) reduces mould on seeds and seedlings. Deeper seeding increases mould and wireworm damage. To control the turnip moth and other cutworms, it is important to cultivate fallow fields thoroughly and loosen the maize inter-rows during egg-laying and early hatching, which destroys many eggs and the weeds the caterpillars feed on.
Для захисту посівів від лугового метелик: To protect crops from the beet webworm, deep autumn ploughing of fields with cocoons, early sowing, regular weed control and inter-row cultivation during pupation are all important.
При запізнюванні зі збиранням кукурудзи: If grain maize harvest is delayed, cobs suffer more from Nigrospora, fusarium and mould fungi, and losses from corn borer and cotton bollworm increase. That is why timely harvest and a short harvest window are key to a successful crop.
Оскільки накопичення органічних речовин: Since the accumulation of dry matter in the grain stops at 40% moisture and harvest maturity comes at 30–35%, the grain harvest should not take longer than 15–20 days. Otherwise losses follow, and they can grow considerably if the maize is hit by frost or wet weather. Organic grain maize is harvested either as whole cobs or with simultaneous threshing. The first method involves cutting the plants, separating the cobs, chopping the stalks, husking, drying and threshing the cobs at a fixed facility.

The best time for taking cuttings is autumn, before the first frosts, so that frost does not damage the buds. At the start of flowering it accumulates in leaves and stem, later moves into the head, and then into the seed. From head formation to the end of flowering, plants take up 60–70% of their total phosphorus need. A phosphorus shortage hurts seed formation and filling and limits productivity. An optimal soil phosphorus level raises drought tolerance and the oil content of the seed. Phosphorus also matters early in development: plants use it intensively then, and there must be enough.

From emergence to head formation, moderate nitrogen and potassium are needed, but phosphorus demand is higher. From head formation to the end of flowering, all nutrients must be in sufficient supply.
